name: SubpoenaResponseTracker
tagline: Never miss an objection or compliance deadline on a third-party subpoena again.
description: Complete Power Platform app for third-party subpoenas, civil investigative demands and regulator information requests: intake register, deadline calendar with objection and response dates, response board with stage rules, custodian and legal-hold coverage, and a production log with Bates-range control. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Objection deadline calculation and waiver warning
Stage rules with required fields per stage
Drag-and-drop board with keyboard Move to
Custodian load and legal-hold gap detection
Bates parsing, overlap and count checks, next-range assignment
Bulk counsel, priority, stage and CSV export with undo
Phone layout with agenda and bottom navigation
